text:
Leon Draisaitl passed 1,100 career points last weekend, and the milestone landed in the middle of one of his best starts: 23 goals and 47 points in 27 games, neck and neck with Cutter Gauthier atop the Rocket Richard race he won in 2024-25.

The process is everything you'd want. His own chances are up to 1.53 expected goals per 60 from 1.02 last season, Edmonton takes 60% of the 5v5 shot attempts with him on the ice, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 99th percentile among forwards for primary shot assists last season, with clean possession exits 71% of the time. Evolving-Hockey had him sixth among 401 forwards in wins above replacement.

Our numbers flag the finishing. Twenty-three goals on 15.2 expected, shooting 23% against 19% last season, and the Oilers have scored 22 more goals than expected with him on the ice. We mark him due to cool. Even so, our season-end range runs from 46 to 65 goals. He is shooting above his talent, and his talent is enormous.
headline: Leon Draisaitl, 1,100 points and a hot stick
